content: Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I is an apology in response to the accusations of Ibn Turka's enemies in Yazd made against him at Shāhrukh's court in Herat: an introduction with autobiographical details and a discussion of the superficial character and base motives of his accusers, then a commentary on nine hadith against bidʿa and one on sayings of Sufi masters supporting the orthodoxy of Sufism.
